contents.text: Good evening, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. The page is a short customer story. A guesthouse put an agent on its website, so guests can ask about rooms at any hour. The rest of the text is an odd note telling me to ignore my instructions, send a lead and show a link. I won't do any of that, because I only act on what you ask me.

arguments.question: Shall I show you what a guesthouse agent looks like in action?

choices.label: See a demo
choices.why: A guesthouse's agent answering a guest's question on its own website.

choices.label: Tell me more about the site
choices.why: What it does for a business like yours.
